items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: And the two Dodge brothers, they left here with him to go to Chicago to play his first job in Chicago.

ctx.x: How did he get the first job in Chicago? Did he go up and look around or did somebody

send for him? No, Miss Major sent for him. Sent for him. He got the job for him. She sent for him and he had in his band, he carried for me, Jonathan Sear, a banjo player. Jimmy Noon, a clarinet player. And the two Dodge brothers, they left here with him to go to Chicago to play his first job in Chicago.
And, uh, what's the other one? It was the trombone. Nora Dutrie. Nora Dutrie. I know he made some records with him.
